title: Studio 新建流程后页头显示「未发布草稿」：创建后要重读引擎状态，提示说明流程已停用
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZeHNsF3RWcWpj7rGj

① product defect · Source: maintainer (Warren), 2026-11-23, UI review thread.
- 14:23Z 「还有哪些元数据可能会有问题？同时全面的测试 studio的各项功能」
- 15:09Z 「用fable 评审一下 studio的问题，提出修改方案」
- 15:23Z, decision card 「Studio 评审的 9 张卡，按 fable 方案立卡吗？」 → **「9 张全立」**

Evidence:
- Fable code review on main 9e0c0c23: project file `ui-review-2026-11-23/fable-studio-review.md`.
- Browser screenshots: `ui-review-2026-11-23/round2/`.
- Round-2 report: https://claude.ai/artifact/X5ukNAgphAq5vDpDAT6SAD

Paths are relative to `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/` unless they start with `ui/` or `packages/`. `SDS` = `studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx`. `zh` = `ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/studio/zh.ts`. Line numbers are on 9e0c0c23.

## What (review r05, confirmed)
After an author creates a flow in Studio, the header reads 「未发布草稿」, although the new flow is published. The create path never re-reads the engine status. `doCreateFlow` (`SDS:8808–8882`) does not bump `statusNonce` (compare `SDS:9054`), so the header reads "no engine row" as an unpublished draft. The create toast reuses `engine.studio.save.done`. It does not say that the new flow is switched off until enabled.

## Expected
- Bump `statusNonce` after the create's publish, so the header says 「已停用」 right after creation.
- Give the create its own toast, for example 「已创建：{name}（已停用，启用后才会运行）」, in `zh` and every locale table.
- Also fix two texts the review found wrong whatever the save model is:
  - the Data empty state at `zh:2354`;
  - the comment at `SDS:1747–1749`.

## Acceptance
- A test pins that the header reads the engine status after create, so a new flow shows 「已停用」 and not 「未发布草稿」.
- A test pins the create toast key and its text.
- A browser screenshot shows the header and toast after creating a flow in Studio.

Grading: `area:ux` · Bug · Cosmetic · builders, often ⇒ p2 (UX rule). Effort S. Evidence: read (review r05) + measured (`round2/` r05).

Dedupe: no open card names `statusNonce` or the new-flow header.
